svg.title: Central metabolism: selected carbon-flow routes
svg.desc: Glycolysis connects glucose to pyruvate and acetyl-CoA. Branches supply pentose sugars, lactate, fatty acids, and the TCA cycle. A circular eight-intermediate TCA cycle supplies glutamate. ATP, NADH, NADPH, and FADH2 accounting and oxidative phosphorylation are shown. Nucleotides, lipids, and proteins illustrate biosynthetic products. This is a simplified, non-stoichiometric map.
